answers.question: How many days does it take for a new card to arrive?
answers.answer: Standard delivery takes 5 to 7 working days. Express delivery takes 2 working days.

answers.question: How much does express card delivery cost?
answers.answer: Express delivery costs £5.

answers.question: My card still hasn't come after two weeks. What do I do?
answers.answer: Report it in the app under Cards > Card not received. We’ll cancel the missing card and send you a replacement free of charge.

answers.question: How do I activate the card I just received?
answers.answer: Open the app, go to Cards > Activate card, and enter the 6‑digit code printed on the letter that came with your card. The card will work immediately after activation.

answers.question: I entered the wrong PIN three times and now it is blocked
answers.answer:
Your PIN is blocked after 3 wrong attempts.  
You can unblock it in the app under Cards > Unblock PIN.  
If the app doesn’t allow it, an agent can unblock it for you.

answers.question: What is the maximum amount I can top up per day?
answers.answer: The maximum daily top‑up is £5,000.

answers.question: Is there a fee for topping up with a debit card?
answers.answer: Top‑ups by debit card are free up to £3,000 per month. Above that, a 0.5 % fee applies.

answers.question: My top-up failed. When do I get the money back?
answers.answer: If a top‑up fails, the money is returned to your card within 5 working days.

answers.question: Which exchange rate do you use on weekdays?
answers.answer: We use the interbank exchange rate on weekdays.

answers.question: Do you charge more for currency exchange at the weekend?
answers.answer: Yes. On weekends (Saturday and Sunday) we add a 1% markup to the exchange rate.

answers.question: How much currency can I exchange per month without paying a fee?
answers.answer: You can exchange up to £1,000 per month without a fee.

answers.question: How much cash can I withdraw for free each month?
answers.answer: You can withdraw up to £200 per month for free.

answers.question: What is the daily ATM withdrawal limit?
answers.answer: Your daily ATM withdrawal limit is £500.

answers.question: The cash machine swallowed my card
answers.answer: Freeze the card in the app right away and order a replacement under Cards > Replace card. Don’t wait for the ATM owner to return it.

answers.question: I lost my card. What should I do?
answers.answer:
Freeze your card immediately in the app under Cards > Freeze card.  
Then report it under Cards > Report lost or stolen.  
We’ll cancel it and send you a new card free of charge.

answers.question: There are payments on my account that I did not make
answers.answer: If you report the unauthorized payments within 60 days, we will refund them after our investigation. The investigation usually takes up to 10 working days.

answers.question: How long does an international transfer take?
answers.answer: International transfers take 1 to 3 working days, depending on the country and currency.

answers.question: How much does it cost to send money abroad?

answers.question: Can I cancel a bank transfer I sent?
answers.answer: You can cancel a transfer only while it is still pending. Completed transfers cannot be cancelled; contact the recipient instead.

answers.question: Which documents can I use to verify my identity?
answers.answer:
You can use a passport, a national identity card or a driving licence.  
You also need to take a selfie in the app so we can match your face to the photo on the document.

answers.question: Why do you need to verify my identity?
answers.answer: Banks must confirm who their customers are by law, to prevent fraud and money laundering. Until your identity is verified, you cannot use all account features.

answers.question: Is my card a Visa or a Mastercard?
answers.answer: Your card is a Visa debit card.

answers.question: How old do I have to be to open an account?
answers.answer: You must be at least 18 years old to open a Demo Bank account.

answers.question: How do I close my account?
answers.answer: Move all your money out first so the balance is zero. Then go to Profile > Close account in the app. Closing is free and takes effect immediately.

answers.question: Can I add my card to Apple Pay?
answers.answer: Yes, you can add your Demo Bank card to Apple Pay. Just go to Cards > Add to wallet in the app. Once added, you can use it wherever contactless payments are accepted.
